attestations.text: Lo Ta-kang 羅大綱 (d. 1856, some sources say 1855), a native of Chieh-yang, Kwangtung, joined the insurgents with his followers. The force quickly rose to about 10,000 men who believed Hung Hsiu-ch'üan had been appointed by Heaven to be their leader.
